title: Adaptive fan-out for sutra_explore
description:
## Parent

sutra/169 — PRD: sutra_explore

## What to build

Add adaptive fan-out to the explore pipeline: from ranked grep hits, walk call/dep edges to surface the callers and callees that a subagent would discover on its next rounds of calls.

1. Hit-density depth heuristic: 1-3 unique hits after dedup → 2 hops, 4-9 → 1 hop, 10+ → 0 hops (grep matches alone are sufficient).
2. Walk call graph edges from ranked hits using existing DB call-graph queries. Both callers and callees at each hop.
3. Score decay: fan-out items get parent_score × 0.5 per hop, so they rank below direct hits.
4. Provenance tagging: each item carries `reason: "direct_match"` or `reason: "fan_out"`.
5. Edges: include call/dep edges between items that appear in the final response (not all edges in the graph — only those connecting response items).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 1-3 grep hits → response includes 2-hop neighbors
- [ ] 4-9 grep hits → response includes 1-hop neighbors
- [ ] 10+ grep hits → no fan-out, direct matches only
- [ ] Fan-out items score below direct matches of equal structural importance
- [ ] Items tagged with reason field (direct_match / fan_out)
- [ ] Edges array contains only edges between items in the response
